data.description:
## Context / Problem
The `rebar-janitor` skill's discovery phase (`examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/phases/discovery.md`) covers tests only as "smelly/missing tests" under concern #7 (lines 51-52, operationalised by an `rg` count of files with fewer than two assertions in `references/patterns.md:116-118`) and change-detector tests under concern #11 (lines 119-132). It has no concern for oracle strength — assertions that cannot fail on the contract's violation — or for contract-coverage gaps, and `phases/verification.md:115` assigns `prod_impact = none` to test-only findings, so weak-test findings start below the impact floor. None of six weak-test bugs from 7–21 Aug 2026 (`obvious-saline-gerbil`, `sound-bumpkinly-thrush`, `tapestried-abhorrent-tuna`, `lowcost-unsainted-wallaby`, `whacky-cadaverous-coati`, `paper-spiritous-halicore`) would have surfaced on a pre-bug tree. The diff-time rubric that names these antipatterns already exists in `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-tests.md` but runs only on a diff, never on the resting tree. Approved 2026-08-21. Project testing philosophy: behavioural and contractual testing, not coverage percentage.

## Approach
Add discovery concern #12 "Oracle strength and contract coverage", sharded by test-tree region like #10/#11, and cross-reference it from #11. The brief to the discovery subagent: for each test, identify the contract under test (docstring, ADR, `--help`, schema statement) and the oracle (assertion set); report a finding when the oracle cannot fail on the contract's violation; apply the antipattern list in `code-review-tests.md` by reference (single source of truth, not restated); additionally flag as project-specific instances: an absent-string subprocess assertion with no `returncode`/`check=True`; a wall-clock budget standing in for an observable event; a fixture mutating state it did not create; an equivalence test whose two sides use different hardening helpers; an oracle encoding a policy preference the contract does not state; and contract-coverage gaps — a documented promise for which no test fails when it is broken, proven by naming the violating input. Evidence shape extends the discovery schema with `contract` (quote + path:line), `oracle` (quote + path:line), `escape_input` (a concrete state the oracle accepts), `antipattern_id`, `scope` (sibling-site count). Verification: `harm_reachable` requires a tree-state demonstration (run against a deliberately broken stub, or reason the escape input through the assertion) — otherwise HARDENING, not DEFECT; amend `verification.md:115` so a test-only finding takes `prod_impact` from the production contract it fails to guard. Do not flag: mocks at external boundaries, exact-value asserts on pure functions, exit-code or stdout greps of the executed unit, Rule-5 structural greps on instruction artifacts, strict `xfail` with a named removal condition, secondary settling sleeps beside a deterministic primary mechanism, bare "no test for X" without a violating input. When the janitor finds a class the rubric lacks, the remediation ticket adds it to `code-review-tests.md` so diff review catches it prospectively.

## Scope
`examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/SKILL.md`, `examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/phases/discovery.md`, `examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/phases/verification.md`, `examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/references/patterns.md`, `docs/` page that documents the janitor concerns (if present), `tests/unit/test_skill_frontmatter.py` (existing skill lint).

## Testing
Skill documentation change; `scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py` and docs gates pass. Dry run: execute the discovery concern over `tests/unit` on the pre-fix tree of `obvious-saline-gerbil` (its fix commit's parent) and confirm the absent-string oracle is reported with an `escape_input`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `discovery.md` contains concern #12 with the brief, the evidence schema fields, and the do-not-flag list; checked by reading the file.
- [ ] `verification.md` scores test-only findings by the guarded production contract and requires a tree-state demonstration for DEFECT; checked by reading the file.
- [ ] The dry run on the gerbil pre-fix tree reports the absent-string oracle with a concrete `escape_input`; checked by the run transcript attached to this ticket.
data.title: rebar-janitor concern #12: oracle strength and contract coverage, scored by the guarded contract
